name: Activepieces
summary: Open-source automation workspace with chat, agents, flows and tables connecting to 760+ apps.
description: Activepieces combines workflow automation, AI agents, chat and data tables in one workspace with more than 760 app connectors and an MCP server. Its core is open source and can be self-hosted. The hosted Free plan needs no card; Plus costs a flat $20 per month with ten times the free usage and pay-as-you-go beyond that, and Team costs $200 per month. Enterprise features include audit logs and embedding.

howToUse.title: Open Activepieces
howToUse.description: Go to Activepieces and choose Open app. One workspace combines data tables, chat, AI agents and workflow automation.

howToUse.title: Connect apps and the MCP server
howToUse.description: Add connectors for more than 760 apps and connect the MCP server so agents and flows run in the tools the team already uses.

howToUse.title: Host it or stay on the Free plan
howToUse.description: Stay on the hosted Free plan if you do not want a card, or self-host the open-source core. Plus is a flat $20 per month and includes ten times the free usage before pay-as-you-go. Team is $200 per month. Enterprise adds audit logs and embedding.
